brief: 🔥 CISA lists exploited WordPress Core (CVE-2026-119977) and Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-118527, CVE-2026-111357) flaws — confirm patch levels in test environments.
🍎 Apple CVE-2024-27834, an improper authentication flaw across iOS, macOS and Safari, is now actively exploited — retest auth flows on patched builds.
🚨 Kyverno received a wave of critical CVEs (CVE-2026-122303, CVE-2026-122304) letting namespace tenants cross boundaries — review multi-tenant cluster policies.
🔐 OpenSSH shipped an emergency fix: long passwords bypassed SSH auth on Alpine Linux — add oversized-input cases to your authentication tests.
🎭 Playwright v1.65.0 adds Bun support for the test runner, failure-only reports and an exclusive test lock.

top_news.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
top_news.snippet: On some Alpine Linux servers, attackers can log into passwordless accounts by supplying a password of 257 to 1,024 bytes. OpenSSH rated the flaw critical and released version 10.6p2 to fix it.
top_news.why: A textbook boundary-value bug: oversized input bypassing authentication is exactly what testers should probe.

top_news.title: v1.65.0
top_news.snippet: Adds Bun support for the test runner through a --bun flag, with some features that behave differently under Bun. It also adds reports that include only failures and a new exclusive test lock.
top_news.why: New Playwright release with Bun runner support and failure-only reports that can slim CI artifacts.

top_news.title: How to Review AI-Generated Test Cases Before You Trust Them
top_news.snippet: I'm the only QA engineer on a large development team, so I use AI a lot.
top_news.why: Practical checklist for vetting AI-written tests before they enter your suite.

top_news.title: An AI agent tested Toolshop from just the URL: 23 issues, 8 real
top_news.snippet: Toolshop's sign-up page says a password needs at least 8 characters.
top_news.why: Honest look at the signal-to-noise ratio of autonomous AI testing agents.

top_news.title: Your LLM app regresses silently. Version-guard it before the next ship.
top_news.snippet: LLM-powered features have a failure mode traditional software doesn't: they degrade without breaking.
top_news.why: Regression-testing strategy for LLM features that degrade without failing outright.

top_news.title: Nearly 1.5 million exposed secrets targeted in new revocation program
top_news.snippet: Truffle Security launched a free Secrets Revocation Program to help API key issuers revoke about 1.4 million publicly exposed, still-valid secrets.
top_news.why: Reminder to scan test fixtures, CI logs and repos for leaked live credentials.

top_news.title: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
top_news.snippet: A fix for a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint is available only through a Microsoft Store update, not Windows Update.
top_news.why: Shows why patch verification must cover every delivery channel, not just the main updater.

top_news.title: Malicious Browser Extensions Could Use Claude Dispatch to Run Code on Users' Computers
top_news.snippet: Researchers at Forever Security showed that an extension able to run scripts on claude.ai could make Claude Desktop execute code via the Dispatch feature.
top_news.why: AI desktop integrations add new trust boundaries that security test plans need to cover.
